p0_closure.evidence: v5.1 canonical base with one producer, one verifier, one store, and one receipt contract
bounded 1:N and N:1 reconciliation plus value-date, duplicate, reversal, and one-terminal-component enforcement are independently recomputed by the isolated verifier
receipt-bound exact-rational FX with source fee, target fee, and spread conservation
authority and verifier CDHash pins reject missing, constant, and mismatched identities
the verifier receives no signing seed; the native Keychain authority alone signs receipts

repository-wide generated-file closure and changed-source secret gates are implemented; production secret rotation, signing, notarization, hosted provenance, real-bank vectors, and M3 execution remain external
